chunks: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. So, what do you bid?
ai.seo_question: What was Pharaoh's plan against the Israelites according to Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Shu'ara, this verse highlights the psychological warfare employed by Pharaoh, who sought to delegitimize Moses' divine mission by attributing it to sorcery rather than prophethood. The rhetorical question 'What do you command?' underscores the internal deliberation of the Israelites, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the tension between faith and political authority during the Exodus narrative.
